title: Cool stock market AI Site
author: Sea-Hunter4552
selftext:
I've been checking out **SandDollar AI** recently ([https://sanddollar-ai.ai.studio](https://sanddollar-ai.ai.studio/)) and it seems like a pretty interesting tool for tracking stocks and researching market trends. One thing I found unique is that it has a **one-time $6 Pro upgrade** instead of another monthly subscription, which is getting rare these days.

I've only spent a little time testing it so far, but I'm curious what others think. Has anyone here used it regularly? What features have you found most useful, and how does it compare to other investing or stock research tools you use?
